thread:
sophia: Heads-up from our onboarding run: sampleapp CI leaked an API key into job logs because the onboarding script was grepping output from `redwood auth rotate` and echoing it into a file.

dan: ouch. which script?

sophia: `samples/nextjs/setup.sh` — it tries to be helpful and does `redwood auth rotate --interactive | sed -n 's/^New API key: //p' > /tmp/key.txt` then `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=$(cat /tmp/key.txt)`.

oliver: that pattern is dangerous. rotation command should never emit the full key on stdout. We need both CLI fix (no stdout secret) and sample fix.

dan: agreed. quick wins: update sample to use `redwood auth rotate --output-file ~/.redwood/credentials` and then `chmod 600`. Also stop recommending `export ...` in docs.

qa-bot: checklist: 1) run grep across samples for `auth rotate` 2) run grep for `export REDWOOD_API_KEY` in dockerfiles 3) add CI lint rule to fail if plaintext keys in repos.

sophia: also a UX issue: SDK precedence is unclear. We had user confusion where REDWOOD_PROJECT env is ignored because token scope is winning silently. Need explicit precedence and an audible warning.

oliver: proposed precedence: constructor arg > CLI flag > REDWOOD_PROJECT env > token scope. If env and token disagree, log at warn level with details and include `REDWOOD_PROJECT_STRICT=true` to promote it to an error.

dan: for rotation propagation we should expose `client.reloadCredentials()` and a small unix socket the CLI can ping to notify running dev servers to reload creds. That keeps long-lived processes consistent.

sophia: security note: add deny-if-stdout-is-not-tty behavior for rotate; i.e., refuse to print full key when stdout is piped and exit 1 with guidance.

security: agreed. we'll also run a repo secret scan and rotate any leaked keys found. Recommend an emergency revocation for any keys found in CI logs.

dan: I'll open PRs: CLI patch (deny-if-piped + masked output + --output-file), sample app fixes (no cat /tmp, use secure file), SDK patch (precedence + reload API + warn/strict mode). ETA: 72h.

sophia: thanks — please ping support and solutions with migration notes. small doc snippet to add to quickstart: safe rotation example and CI guidance.

qa-bot: created task RW-DEVEX-1350 for the rollout & lint enforcement.
